question: When is the samayin from hand-clap, and what should the guru give?
premises: at appointed time, from hand-clap thus
in auspicious enjoyment-hand, as it were
inference: Hand-clap timing opens enjoyment-hand giving of left-nectar.
plain_english: At appointed time, from hand-clap thus — in auspicious enjoyment-hand as it were — the guru should give left-nectar-flooded.
